events.title: Co-op, rebuilt: two full heroes, local or online
events.summary: Co-op in ALL EYES ON ME used to mean a sidekick: the second player had no weapons and no say in the build. We tore that down and rebuilt it. Now there are two full heroes, at one screen or online. Two full heroes Your own form. Each player picks their own character and plays with their own weapons, passives, health and Reflex. Both of you pick at every level-up. One shared XP bar, two choices per level, so both builds grow at full speed. The screen tells you in big letters whose turn it is. Fall

events.title: Next Fest is live: the free demo now has 21 bosses and 21 elites
events.summary: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. ALL EYES ON ME is in Steam Next Fest until October 26. The free demo is the whole first stage, then THE DEPTH, an endless mode where the rules keep stacking. A descent takes 10 to 30 minutes, and your demo progress carries over to the full game on November 12. Since our last major update, we've added 26 regular bosses and 33 elite enemies across both campaigns, and reworked combat, progression, performance and the first-run experience for the fest. More

events.title: Major update: what's new since the demo came out
events.summary: The demo went out on September 22. Since then the game has changed a lot. This is what you'll notice when you start it again. New bosses Four new guardians in Stage I: VESPER holds its eye between two long arms and attacks in pairs. Survive the second one and its core opens. AEGIS is a golden shield beetle. events.title: The demo is out
events.summary: They all see the same. You don't.The ALL EYES ON ME demo is on Steam. Free, no time limit. The first stage, and below it THE DEPTH: endless. Local co-op included.Stage II, Conquest, Challenges and more stay closed until the full game. Every door shows what's behind it.Your save carries over. What you unlock in the demo, you keep.Tell us what breaks, right here in the forum. If it gets you: wishlist.
